note: Hand-kept map for the Build canvas. Service lines with ids from the live SOW tool (sow/index.html CATALOG) keep their names, hours and sources from there; researched lines come from canvas/research/*.json. 'lines' are on when the play starts, 'more' are optional. Each play lists its products, their places ([column, row] on the canvas grid) any optional lines it turns on from the start ('on') and any starting lines it turns off ('off'). The custom play, Create your own play, lists the products a partner can add and their places on its grid; the canvas packs the chosen ones together. Outside systems (step 27): products marked 'outside' are systems the client runs outside Adobe. A play lists the ones a partner can add ('outside') and their places ('opos'); none is on when the play starts. Step 45: a play's 'addons' are Adobe products a partner can add from the same menu (AEM Assets on the AEM play); 'ostart' lists the outside systems on the canvas when the play starts (the CDN in every Brand Visibility play); 'recommend' tags systems Recommended, with each one's reason in its 'rec'. A line or connection's 'tier' is the package it needs. Step 96: a built play offers outside systems only; 'kept' lists Adobe products a saved canvas keeps but the play no longer offers (AEM Assets on the AEM play).
